character_types: wild-haired man in a suit and tie
visual_synopsis: Shot through a heavy blue day-for-night grade, two men in light overcoats walk and argue their way through a village orchard and up to a hillside cemetery, where one of them wanders alone among the railed graves and headstones. A man with a wild pale mop of hair, in a dark suit, white shirt and tie, is sitting inside one of the grave enclosures talking, and the overcoat man throws his arms wide in disbelief at him.
